```yaml
name: Check Milestone
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - release/7.0
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - release/7.0
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]

jobs:
  check-milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: '7.0.x'

      - name: Verify Package References
        run: |
          # Check Directory.Packages.props for System.Data.Common version
          if ! grep -q "System.Data.Common.*4.3.0" Directory.Packages.props; then
            echo "Error: System.Data.Common v4.3.0 not found in Directory.Packages.props"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check netfx ref project for PackageReference
          if ! grep -q "System.Data.Common" src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient/netfx/ref/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.csproj; then
            echo "Error: System.Data.Common PackageReference not found in netfx ref project"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check main project for PackageReference
          if ! grep -q "System.Data.Common" src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient/src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.csproj; then
            echo "Error: System.Data.Common PackageReference not found in main project"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check nuspec for dependency
          if ! grep -q "System.Data.Common.*4.3.0" tools/specs/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.nuspec; then
            echo "Error: System.Data.Common v4.3.0 dependency not found in nuspec"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All package references verified successfully"

      - name: Build Solution
        run: |
          dotnet restore
          dotnet build -c Release --no-restore

      - name: Run Tests
        run: |
          dotnet test -c Release --no-build --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

      - name: Validate CS0012 Fix
        run: |
          # Test that IDbColumnSchemaGenerator can be referenced without CS0012
          dotnet clean
          dotnet build -c Release --no-restore
          
          # Verify no CS0012 compilation errors occur
          echo "Compilation successful - CS0012 issue resolved"
```
